'''Radlee Mathiss''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] who lived in [[Dearic/Legends|Dearic]] on [[Talus/Legends|Talus]]. In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]], he hired a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] to pick up a package for him from a [[Corporate Sector Authority/Legends|Corporate Sector Authority]] courier. The courier was captured by the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutts]], so Mathiss had the spacer free him. He then had the spacer kill a Hutt [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] as revenge.
